candidates: When a PR imports a named export from a newly-added or upgraded dependency, verify that the export actually exists at the declared version before approving. Check the package's published types, changelog, or source for the pinned version — a mismatch between what the code imports and what the package actually exports will cause a runtime failure that tests may not catch if the package is mocked.

When a PR renames or changes string values that are recorded as telemetry fields (e.g. agent names, event names, dimension keys in code/core/src/telemetry/), flag that existing dashboards, queries, and data pipelines may depend on the old strings. Ask the author to either add a backward-compatible name-mapping layer or obtain explicit team sign-off confirming the breaking change in historical data is acceptable.
